interfaces.note: This declaration must satisfy the protected Main consumer exactly: theorem exists_uniformMissingTraceFamily_strictlyLargerThanStar (d s n : ℕ) (hd : 4 ≤ d) (hslow : (d + 3) / 2 ≤ s) (hshigh : s ≤ d - 1) (hn : 2 * (d + 1) ≤ n) : ∃ family : Finset (Finset (Fin n)), IsUniformMissingTraceFamily d s family ∧ family.card = Nat.choose (n - 1) d + Nat.choose (n - 2 * (d + 1 - s) - 2) (2 * s - d - 2) ∧ Nat.choose (n - 1) d < family.card. Reuse the lower public construction, missing-trace, and counting declarations; no hypothesis or conclusion drift.
